content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Process Transactions ## slug: process-transactions ## seoTitle: Process Transactions ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Use the instructions below to process each type of {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. :::(Info) (Webhooks) In some cases, like ACH processing, you may need to enable webhooks to update statuses asynchronously. Use our [webhook documentation](/v1/docs/webhooks) to complete the setup. ::: ## Authorize Transactions ![Authorizing a Transaction](https://youtu.be/OF0uF8TnUeQ){height="480" width="640"} 1. In the App Launcher, enter and click "Transactions." 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Select {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge." 4. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 5. Complete the following fields. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} (required) * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} (required) * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}} 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 7. Click {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}}. 8. Click {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}}. If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is successful, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} will update to "Completed," and {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Authorized." If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is not captured within seven days, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Uncaptured" when webhooks are enabled. *If this happens, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} can no longer be captured, and you must clone this {{variable.Object_Transaction}} or create a new one.* If you want to capture the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} of the authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, click the **Capture** button to charge the total {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}}. If you want to partially capture an amount, update the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} field to a lesser amount and click **Capture**. (see below for more information). ## Capture Transactions ![Capturing a Transaction](https://youtu.be/NQvyNYdpQj8){height="480" width="640"} 1. In the App Launcher, enter and click "Transactions." 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Select {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge." 4. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 5. Complete the following fields. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} (required) * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} (required) * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}} 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 7. Click **Capture**. 8. Click **Charge**. If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is successful, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} will update to "Completed," and the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Captured." ## Partially Capture Transactions ![Partially Capturing an Authorized Transaction](https://youtu.be/CHuM0_0Q12Y){height="480" width="640"} If a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is successfully authorized, and you decide to capture less than the original {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}}, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will be updated to "Partially Captured." 1. In the App Launcher, enter and click "Transactions." 2. Select the existing {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Authorized." 3. Update the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} field to a lesser amount. 4. Complete the following required fields. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} (required) * {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}} (required) 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 6. Click **Capture**. 7. Click **Charge**. If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is successful, the {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} will update to "Completed," and the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will update to "Partially Captured." ## Release Authorized Transactions The {{variable.Field_Transaction_UncaptMethod}} field shows if an authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was released (refunded) before the seven days. * **"Manual"** means the authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was manually released from the user. * **"Automatic"** means {{variable.Product_Stripe}} automatically released the authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} after seven days. *If you need to release an authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} before seven days, complete the following steps.* 1. In the App Launcher, enter and click "Transaction." 2. Open the authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. 3. Click {{variable.Button_Refund}}. The authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will be released in {{variable.Product_Stripe}}, and the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will be updated to "Refunded." This process will not create a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}}; it will update the existing one. :::(Warning) (In Payments version 4.54 and later...) When you release an authorized {{variable.Object_Transaction}} by clicking **Refund**, a refund {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will not be created, and the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} will be updated to "Uncaptured." ::: ## Non-Gateway Transactions Creating a non-gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is similar to creating a charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, except that a non-gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is not subject to the validations and processes that a charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is subject to. However, you can [refund and partially refund](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/transactions#refundedpartially-refunded-transaction) non-gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s using the {{variable.Button_Refund}} / {{variable.Button_PartialRefund}} buttons and checkboxes as you do for normal {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. 1. In the App Launcher, enter and click "Transaction." 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Set {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge." 4. Click {{variable.Button_Next}}. 5. Complete the following fields. * {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} (required) * {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} (required) * Check the {{variable.Field_Transaction_NonGateway}} checkbox. You can now manually set any fields for the non-gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}} (i.e., cash or a mailed-in check). Non-gateway {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are not processed or captured like charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s.* 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![H_01_12_non gateway transaction](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_12_non%20gateway%20transaction.png){height="" width=""} ## Failed Transactions {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s that fail to process, such as for a declined card, cannot be retried. Instead, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} must be cloned and reattempted. This is the expected functionality because {{variable.Product_Stripe}} maintains IDs, even for failed {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. #### Spreedly If a {{variable.Product_Spreedly}} {{variable.Object_Transaction}} fails, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will contain the following information describing the reason for the failure. * If the response includes an error code, it will be stored in the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorCode}} field. * The {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s token will be stored in the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s {{variable.Field_Transac_SpreedlTranToken}} field. * The date the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} was processed will be stored in the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ProcessedDat}} field. ## Delete Transactions By default, once a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} has any {{variable.Product_Stripe}} fields populated (such as the {{variable.Field_Transaction_ErrorMessage}} or {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactioID}}), you cannot delete it. If you need to delete a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, you must turn off the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} validations in the [custom settings](/v1/docs/custom-settings). This is the expected behavior because Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} was built to mirror the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} database. ## Adjustment Transactions Stripe creates this {{variable.Object_Transaction}} type via {{variable.Task_Webhook}}. It should not be manually created. ## Checkboxes for Declarative Automation In addition to the {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}}, {{variable.Button_Refund}}, and **Capture** buttons to process charge {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s, there are checkbox fields that mirror the buttons' functions. The {{variable.Field_Transaction_Authorize}}, {{variable.Field_Transaction_Capture}}, or {{variable.Field_Transaction_Refund}} checkboxes allow you to process {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s automatically without a button. When Auto-Process runs, if {{variable.Field_Transaction_Authorize}}, {{variable.Field_Transaction_Capture}}, or {{variable.Field_Transaction_Refund}} are checked, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} will be authorized, captured, or refunded. Each checkbox performs the same process as if you clicked the {{variable.Button_Transaction_Authorize}}, **Capture**, or {{variable.Button_Refund}} button. (The {{variable.Field_Transaction_Authorize}}, {{variable.Field_Transaction_Capture}}, or {{variable.Field_Transaction_Refund}} fields are on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object but are not on the {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge" {{variable.Object_Transaction}} page layout.) ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with your {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](/v1/docs/troubleshooting-payments) page.
